rules.question: Is Star Power running at this moment?
rules.decision: D115 (M48, code-only); D115, concept audit M48 (plan question 6); SPE-T7 ("Merge them now"): the highway's sp_active field asks the same rule.
must_match: if (w && struck_at(now, w->first) && now < w->second) return &a;
const bool a = struck_at(t, w.first) && t < w.second;
rules.note: A playhead or instant tested against a Star Power window by hand instead of through sp_running_in. PreviewActivation::sp_running_at (the drain and score boxes) and render::SpRunSweep (the highway's sp_active field) both ask it.

rules.question: Is Star Power running at an instant of the highway?
rules.decision: SPE-T7 ("Merge them now"): one owner for SP running; the highway's sp_active field asks app::sp_running_in through SpRunSweep.
must_match: SpanSweep overdrive, solo, fill, fill_taken, fill_ghost, sp_active, fill_lane;
must_not_match: SpanSweep overdrive, solo, fill, fill_taken, fill_ghost, fill_lane;
rules.note: The highway's sp_active field built with the generic span sweep, which keeps its own edge rule, instead of SpRunSweep, which asks app::sp_running_in.
